dedupe_keys.name: transportation sector scenario dependent final energy demands by fuel at nuts2 level eu 27

description: The iDesignRES project publishes scenario-dependent transport energy-demand inputs prepared to link GENeSYS-MOD, GeoMEC and JRC-EU-TIMES-OP. The provider describes final energy demands downscaled from national NUTS-0 results to NUTS-2 regions of the EU-27, with fuel categories adapted to GeoMEC. The collection also includes demands by transport sector and an average hourly profile expressing the relative distribution of direct electricity demand. Zenodo version 0.1, published on 22 December 2025, lists a ZIP data archive and a PDF description. The source describes this as a first release with further improvements planned; the metadata does not prove those improvements occurred. These are scenario and model-coupling inputs. They are distinct from the separately catalogued 2024 regional demand estimates, which use another DOI and observed-source downscaling. Caveats: scenario years, units, individual fields and archive contents remain unverified because no files were downloaded. Access: free public access through Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Related resources include the project community and the linked catalogue entries.
